# v0.5.0 發行準備紀錄 / Release preparation record

## 繁體中文

### 目的、版本與來源

本紀錄是 [Issue #36](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/issues/36) 的點時發行準備資料，不是新的正式契約或 publication 證據。依 [版本方式](../../CHANGELOG.md)，準備 minor `v0.5.0`：[#34／PR #35](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/pull/35) 新增共用寫作契約並調整讀取義務，不沿用 v0.4.1 的 patch 澄清判定。版本號不保證模型、工具、接口或 runtime 相容。

內容基線為已合併的完整 commit [`e603e36df892e8b29c75c68c36cbf03958aaa271`](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/commit/e603e36df892e8b29c75c68c36cbf03958aaa271)，保留其 reviewed head `61443c9dc2792400104cc7ae94059c8fbe6adb03` 的來源關係。發行準備文件合併後，才固定最終 publication commit；不能將本基線直接當成包含新版本條目的最終 tag target。

### 發行內容與保護範圍

相較 v0.4.1，v0.5.0 納入以下已合併內容：

- [共用寫作契約](../../contracts/writing.md)支援一般文章、技術文件與混合文類，保留作者聲音、技術精度及必要安全資訊。
- [wf-writing](../../contracts/workflow.md#wf-writing) 保留 anchor 與簡短最低要求；一般交付摘要不自動載入全文，文件任務與影響步驟、風險或重要結論的實質短修改按影響處理。
- 忠實引用列來源，不普遍要求作者重做引用實驗；自行研究或效果主張保留相稱真實資料、方法及基準要求。繁中採自然台灣用語；STE 聲明允許等義表達，保留完整符合性未驗證與下游加嚴限制。
- [非權威設計與案例](../architecture/original-writing-design.md)、[來源與遷移對照](../provenance/source-map.md#original-writing-update)，以及 README／CHANGELOG 的相應導讀。

本發行準備切片只在 CHANGELOG 新增中英版本條目，並新增本檔。相對上述 #34 合併基線，五份正式契約及其他既有文件的 bytes／mode 保持；CHANGELOG 原有每行及行序也保留。#23 完整接受機制、其他必要安全／授權／審查義務、[LICENSE](../../LICENSE)、完整 [notices](../provenance/upstream-notices.md) 及所有歷史不因發版而改寫。

基線有 30 檔；本切片預期形成 31 檔，即 30 份 Markdown 與 LICENSE，均為 regular Git mode `100644`。實際發行須對最終 tree 核對完整清冊、每檔 raw SHA-256、總 bytes 及集合 digest；不能只改版本字串或重用 v0.4.1 的 28 檔清冊。集合算法為：按 UTF-8 path 排序，將每筆 `path<TAB>raw-file-SHA256<LF>` 串接後計算 SHA-256。

### 驗證、審查與安全

本包須核對實際範圍、原文保護、本地 links／anchors、whitespace、中英重要資訊與版本角色一致性。Core 是純 Markdown，沒有 catalog、程式套件、installer 或 CI；不為發版新增這些機制，也不把未設定／未執行的 CI 記為 Passed。

#34 的完整 Merge Review、寫作案例及另外的人工安全審查，可在原始內容、範圍、假設與環境仍吻合時重用；它們不代替本發行準備差異的獨立文件審查，也不代替新 PR head 的完整 base-to-head Merge Review。靜態案例不是模型實測或 runtime 資格證據。私有查核資料由接口保存，不放入 Core。

SDS 適用性依 [實際影響](../../contracts/review-and-security.md#review-security) 判定，不以 Markdown、工具限制或人工零發現豁免。本切片不更改權限、認證、敏感資料處理、執行、依賴或安裝控制；仍以實際差異與獨立審查記錄判定結果。先前未完成的工具掃描保持其未完成狀態，人工安全審查另行保留，均不得改稱 SDS Passed。

每次 commit、push、PR、merge、tag 與 Release 前，依既有[公開資料檢查](../../contracts/review-and-security.md#review-publication-data)核對實際內容、完整範圍、raw metadata、訊息／trailer、簽章可見資訊及目的地；不為此取得私鑰或簽署秘密。未知、漂移或未完成的必要資料阻擋相依操作，有界查核不保證零風險。

### Publication 與下游採用

先完成版本條目的審查及合併，再固定完整 publication commit、tree 與文件集合。確認沒有同名衝突且不覆寫既有歷史後，才依有效授權建立 annotated tag `v0.5.0` 與正式 GitHub Release `Core v0.5.0`。正式 Release 預期 `draft=false`、`prerelease=false`，target 為該完整 commit；正文只包含已核對的發行內容、來源與限制。

建立後分別讀回 tag object／解析 commit 與 Release 的 tag、target、正文及 draft／prerelease。文件版本、準備紀錄或測試不能代替這些 publication 證據；這份準備紀錄在發布後仍保留原文，不回填成執行結果，也不在 README 鏡像 mutable latest。

Core 與 Codex、Grok、Claude 各自管理版本，不要求同步發行。本包不改 consumer、安裝、啟動或全域設定；後續採用各自固定正式 revision、完整清冊／digest／引用閉包，驗證入口、閱讀條件及自身較嚴要求。共享 Markdown 或發布成功不證明 runtime 已採用、實際遵循或相容，也不提供任何其他環境的 #23 接受紀錄。

英文技術文字依 ASD-STE100 Issue 9 原則編寫，尚未完成正式規則、受控詞典及適用技術詞的完整符合性驗證。繁體中文採自然台灣用語與一致術語，不宣稱符合官方中文 ASD 標準。

## English

### Purpose, version and source

This is the point-in-time release-preparation record for [Issue #36](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/issues/36), not a new formal contract or publication evidence. Prepare minor `v0.5.0` under [the version policy](../../CHANGELOG.md). [#34 / PR #35](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/pull/35) adds a shared writing contract and changes reading duties; do not reuse the v0.4.1 patch-clarification decision. Version numbers do not guarantee model, tool, interface or runtime compatibility.

The content baseline is merged commit [`e603e36df892e8b29c75c68c36cbf03958aaa271`](https://github.com/jeffery777/engineering-workflow-core/commit/e603e36df892e8b29c75c68c36cbf03958aaa271), retaining its source relationship to reviewed head `61443c9dc2792400104cc7ae94059c8fbe6adb03`. Fix the final publication commit after the release-preparation documents merge. The baseline alone does not contain the new version entries and is not the final tag target.

### Release content and preservation

Compared with v0.4.1, include the merged shared writing contract for general articles, technical documents and mixed genres. Keep author voice, precision and required safety information. Retain the wf-writing anchor and short minimum requirements. Routine delivery summaries do not automatically load the full text; document tasks and substantive short changes to steps, risks or important conclusions use the impact-based condition.

Keep faithful citation without a general duty to repeat cited experiments. The author's own research or effect claims need proportionate real data, methods and baselines. Keep natural Taiwan Traditional Chinese, equivalent STE notices, unverified full conformance and stricter downstream requirements. Include the non-authoritative design/cases, source/migration map and corresponding README/CHANGELOG guidance linked above.

This preparation slice only inserts bilingual version entries in CHANGELOG and adds this file. Preserve bytes and modes of the five contracts and every other existing file from the #34 merge baseline. Preserve each earlier CHANGELOG line and its order, the complete #23 acceptance mechanism, other mandatory safety/authority/review duties, LICENSE, full notices and history.

The 30-file baseline is expected to become 31 files: 30 Markdown files and LICENSE, all regular Git mode `100644`. Verify the final tree's complete inventory, per-file raw SHA-256, total bytes and set digest. A version-string change or the old 28-file v0.4.1 inventory is insufficient. Sort UTF-8 paths, concatenate `path<TAB>raw-file-SHA256<LF>` rows and SHA-256 the result.

### Verification, review and safety

Check actual scope, preservation, local links/anchors, whitespace, bilingual important information and version-state coherence. Core is pure Markdown with no catalog, program package, installer or CI. Add none for this release and do not report unconfigured or unexecuted CI as Passed.

Reuse #34's complete Merge Review, writing cases and separate manual security review only while original content, scope, assumptions and environment match. They do not replace independent document review of this preparation diff or complete base-to-head Merge Review for a new PR head. Static cases do not qualify model or runtime behavior. Keep private verification evidence in the interface's controlled storage, outside Core.

Assess SDS from actual impact under the linked security contract, not from file type, missing tools or zero manual findings. This slice changes no permissions, authentication, sensitive-data handling, execution, dependencies or installation controls; record the decision from actual diff and independent review. Preserve the earlier tool scan as incomplete and the manual review separately; neither becomes SDS Passed.

Before each commit, push, PR, merge, tag and Release, inspect actual content, complete range, raw metadata, messages/trailers, visible signature data and destinations under the existing publication-data contract. Do not obtain private keys or signing secrets. Unknown, changed or incomplete required data stops its dependent action; bounded checks do not guarantee zero risk.

### Publication and downstream adoption

Review and merge version entries before fixing the complete publication commit, tree and document set. Check for name conflicts and preserve existing history, then create annotated `v0.5.0` and formal GitHub Release `Core v0.5.0` under effective authority. The expected formal Release has `draft=false`, `prerelease=false` and the exact full commit target; use only reviewed release content, sources and limits in its body.

Read back the tag object/resolved commit and the Release tag, target, body, draft and prerelease states. Source versions, preparation records and tests do not prove publication. Preserve this record after publication without backfilling execution results or mirroring mutable latest in README.

Core, Codex, Grok and Claude manage versions independently without a simultaneous-release requirement. This packet changes no consumer, installation, startup or global setting. Later adoption pins the formal revision, complete inventory/digests/reference closure and verifies its entrypoints, reading conditions and stricter rules. Shared Markdown or successful publication proves no runtime adoption, conformance or compatibility and supplies no #23 acceptance for another environment.

English technical text uses ASD-STE100 Issue 9 principles. Full conformance has not been verified against all formal rules, the controlled dictionary and applicable technical terms. Traditional Chinese uses natural Taiwan wording and consistent terms without claiming an official Chinese ASD standard.
